category_description: How income tax, GST and levies work in New Zealand.
subcategory_description: How income tax and the ACC earners' levy are charged on pay.
label: ACC earners' levy rate
context: The amount is a flat rate on earnings and includes GST. It is deducted with PAYE on pay, up to the maximum earnings.

label: Maximum earnings the ACC earners' levy is charged on
context: Earnings above this amount a year are not charged the levy.

label: Maximum ACC earners' levy payable in a year
context: The most an employee pays in the levy for the year, including GST.

subject_intro: What the ACC earners' levy is, who pays it, how it is collected with PAYE, and the earnings above which no more levy is charged.
subject_meta_description: The ACC earners' levy is {fact:nz_acc_rate} of earnings, up to {fact:nz_acc_max_earn} a year. See who pays it, how it is collected through PAYE and the maximum payable.
